description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waththa Uyandana Mallawapitiya  D/S Division, Kurunegala  District - Cad. Map No,  420209
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 11, Block 01) with detailed cadastral information, location details, and a schedule listing ownership particulars. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes as it deals with land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
